# SLA Capital

> SLA Capital (Sir Lends A Lot LLC) is an AI-enhanced private lender for real
> estate investors, lending in 42 US states. Business-purpose loans only — no
> consumer or owner-occupied home loans. Core residential programs: DSCR rental
> loans, Fix & Flip bridge loans, and New Construction loans; plus commercial
> real estate loans (bridge and DSCR), including owner-occupied commercial property. Transparent pricing: rates are
> published publicly and the rate quoted is the rate at closing, with no
> application fees and no hidden junk fees. NMLS ID #2863552 · Idaho Mortgage Broker/Lender License #MBL-2082863552 · Oregon Mortgage Lending License #2863552 · Certified Member, American
> Association of Private Lenders (AAPL) · 707 W Main Ave #31, Spokane, WA 99201.

Site: https://slacapital.ai
Apply: https://slacapital.ai/apply/
Contact: apply@slacapital.com · (509) 846-7349

## Loan Programs

- [DSCR Rental Loans](https://slacapital.ai/rental/): 30-year fixed rates from
  7.05% (before buy down: highest credit tier, DSCR 1.20+); also 5/6, 7/6, 10/6 ARM and
  5-year interest-only. Loans $100K–$3M. Up to 80% LTV purchase / 75% cash-out.
  Minimum 1.0 DSCR (below-1.0 lane available with reserves or rate adjustment).
  Minimum 660 FICO. No tax returns, no W-2s, no DTI. Close in an LLC. Cash-out
  refinance seasoning is none — pull equity out as soon as the property is ready, and no active lease is required at
  closing (market-rent appraisal qualifies — this is also how short-term
  rentals/Airbnbs are underwritten). Portfolio loans blanket 2–10 properties
  on one note.
- [Fix & Flip Loans](https://slacapital.ai/fix-n-flip/): purchase + rehab
  bridge financing sized off ARV. Rates from 9.5%. Up to 92.5% loan-to-cost
  for experienced borrowers with 100% of the rehab budget funded via draws;
  first-timers welcome (~85% LTC to start). Funding in as little as 72 hours;
  average close 7–10 days. Loans $100K–$3M. 6–18 month terms.
- [New Construction Loans](https://slacapital.ai/new-construction/): land +
  vertical build at up to 85% of land cost and 85% of construction cost. Rates
  from 10%. 18 or 24 month terms with straightforward extensions. Draws via
  online portal with app-based inspections; interest on drawn balance. Loans
  $100K–$7.5M. Spec builds and build-to-rent welcome.
- [Commercial Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/): now offering two
  commercial real estate products, reviewed and priced case by case (no
  published rate). Commercial Bridge Loans up to $20,000,000: short-term
  financing to buy, reposition or refinance a commercial property. Commercial
  DSCR Loans up to $3,000,000: long-term financing for stabilized commercial
  property qualified on the property's income; 5-year hybrid or 15, 25 and
  30-year fixed; full doc, lite doc, bank statement and no-doc options. Both:
  purchase, refinance and cash-out; investor and owner-occupied commercial.
  Property types: multi-family, mixed-use, retail and strip centers, office,
  light industrial, warehouse, self-storage, mobile home parks, commercial
  condos, automotive, restaurants and bars, day care, bulk residential.
  Apply: https://portal.slacapital.ai/commercial
  Financing by commercial property type:
  - [Multifamily Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/multifamily/): Apartment building loans: bridge up to $20M to buy or reposition, and DSCR loans up to $3M for stabilized buildings, qualified on rental income.
  - [Mixed-Use Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/mixed-use/): Mixed-use loans for buildings with storefronts below and apartments or offices above. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M. Investor and owner-occupied.
  - [Retail & Strip Center Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/retail/): Retail and strip center loans: bridge up to $20M to buy or re-tenant, DSCR up to $3M for stabilized centers. Purchase, refinance and cash-out.
  - [Office Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/office/): Office building loans for investors and owner-occupiers, including medical office: bridge up to $20M to buy or reposition, DSCR up to $3M.
  - [Light Industrial Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/light-industrial/): Loans for light industrial, flex and small-bay buildings. Bridge financing up to $20M and DSCR loans up to $3M, for investors and owner-operators.
  - [Warehouse Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/warehouse/): Warehouse and distribution building loans: bridge up to $20M to buy or reposition, DSCR up to $3M for leased warehouses. Investor and owner-occupied.
  - [Self-Storage Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/self-storage/): Self-storage loans: bridge up to $20M for acquisitions, expansions and lease-up, and DSCR up to $3M for stabilized facilities.
  - [Mobile Home Park Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/mobile-home-parks/): Mobile home park and manufactured housing community loans: bridge up to $20M and DSCR up to $3M. Purchase, refinance and cash-out for park investors.
  - [Commercial Condo Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/commercial-condos/): Loans for commercial condominium units: office, retail, medical and industrial condos. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M, for investors and owner-occupiers.
  - [Automotive Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/automotive/): Loans for automotive properties such as repair shops, service centers and dealerships. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M, for investors and owner-operators.
  - [Restaurant & Bar Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/restaurants-bars/): Commercial real estate loans for restaurant and bar buildings, for owner-operators and investors. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M, reviewed case by case.
  - [Day Care Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/day-care/): Real estate loans for day care and child care centers, for owner-operators and investors. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M, reviewed case by case.
  - [Bulk Residential Loans](https://slacapital.ai/commercial/bulk-residential/): Commercial loans for bulk residential purchases: packages of single-family homes, townhomes or condo units bought together. Bridge up to $20M, DSCR up to $3M.

## Guides

- [DSCR Loans Explained](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loans-explained/):

- [DSCR vs. Conventional Mortgage](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-vs-conventional-mortgage/):

  3 vs 6 vs 12 month windows and the BRRRR math.
- [DSCR Loans for Airbnb & STRs](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loans-for-airbnb/):

- [BRRRR Method Financing](https://slacapital.ai/blog/brrrr-method-financing/):

- [Fix & Flip Loans for Beginners](https://slacapital.ai/blog/fix-and-flip-loans-for-beginners/):
  first-deal financing, realistic leverage, and the mistakes that sink flips.
- [Hard Money vs. DSCR](https://slacapital.ai/blog/hard-money-vs-dscr-loans/):

- [Buying Rentals in an LLC](https://slacapital.ai/blog/llc-rental-property-loans/):

- [Spec Home Construction Loans](https://slacapital.ai/blog/spec-home-construction-loans/):
  ground-up financing, the two leverage tests, and planning the exit.

- [Cash-Out Refinance on a Rental Property](https://slacapital.ai/blog/rental-property-cash-out-refinance/):
  the 75% LTV cap, seasoning, a worked equity-out example, and cash-out vs. HELOC.
- [Portfolio Loans for Rental Properties](https://slacapital.ai/blog/portfolio-loans-for-rental-properties/):

- [No-Seasoning Cash-Out Refinance](https://slacapital.ai/blog/no-seasoning-cash-out-refinance/):

- [How to Refinance Out of a Hard Money Loan](https://slacapital.ai/blog/refinance-out-of-a-hard-money-loan/):
  the bridge-to-DSCR exit — timeline, documentation, and fixes when numbers are tight.
- [Build-to-Rent Financing](https://slacapital.ai/blog/build-to-rent-financing/):
  construction loan to DSCR refinance — the BTR two-loan relay and build-vs-buy math.
- [How Many DSCR Loans Can You Have?](https://slacapital.ai/blog/how-many-dscr-loans-can-you-have/):
  no program cap — each loan qualifies on its own property; what actually limits a portfolio.
- [DSCR Prepayment Penalties Explained](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-prepayment-penalties/):
  5-4-3-2-1 vs 3-2-1 step-downs in dollars, buyouts, and matching the term to the hold plan.
- [How Much Money Do You Need to Flip a House?](https://slacapital.ai/blog/how-much-money-do-you-need-to-flip-a-house/):
  the full worked cash budget on a $250K flip — down payment, costs, carry, contingency, reserves.
- [What Credit Score Do You Need for a DSCR Loan?](https://slacapital.ai/blog/what-credit-score-do-you-need-for-a-dscr-loan/):
  660 minimum, but the middle score sets the rate tier; co-guarantors price at the lowest middle.
- [DSCR Loan Down Payment](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loan-down-payment/):
  20% down at 80% LTV plus costs and reserves — worked cash-to-close on a $300K rental.
- [What Is a Hard Money Loan?](https://slacapital.ai/blog/what-is-a-hard-money-loan/):
  short-term asset-based lending explained — anatomy, real cost, and when it's the right tool.
- [DSCR Loans for Duplexes, Triplexes & Fourplexes](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loans-for-2-4-unit-properties/):
  combined unit rents qualify against one payment; no owner-occupancy — the house-hacking rule.
- [LTV vs. LTC vs. ARV](https://slacapital.ai/blog/ltv-ltc-arv-explained/):

- [Investment Property Insurance Requirements](https://slacapital.ai/blog/investment-property-insurance-requirements/):

## State Coverage

State-specific program pages exist at /rental/<state>/, /fix-n-flip/<state>/,
and /new-construction/<state>/ for 41 states (e.g.
https://slacapital.ai/rental/florida/). Full list in the
[sitemap](https://slacapital.ai/sitemap.xml).

## Partner Programs

- [Preferred Partners — for mortgage brokers](https://slacapital.ai/brokers/):
  invitation-only broker portal. Brokers price business-purpose loans (DSCR 1–4 unit and
  multifamily 5+, fix & flip / bridge, ground-up construction) against SLA's live rate
  sheets, download or e-send a branded term sheet, submit in one step, and track every
  deal to funding. Broker points and processing fee are paid at closing (some programs via
  Bill.com after closing); a borrower stays tied to the broker for 365 days from their
  last loan together. No cost to join. Request access at slacapital.ai/brokers.
- [Knights of the Realm — referral program](https://slacapital.ai/knights/):
  for wholesalers, agents, property managers, educators, contractors, CPAs and creators
  who refer real estate investors. SLA Capital is the lender and handles everything after
  the investor applies; Knights never quote rates or take applications. Knights earn a
  revenue share (a referral fee) on the first loan each referred investor closes, paid
  monthly through Bill.com, plus a co-branded page, short link, QR code and ready-made
  marketing materials. Free to join; apply at portal.slacapital.ai/knights-join.
